notes: RBox expansion paired with literature_arts-replace-0010 (which makes 'collaborated with' not symmetric): a made-up relation, quill_sworn_to (writer to writer), is given the same property, applied to real novelists. The pairs are writers who are not known to have been tied by any real pledge, so no world fact bears on the answers and only the edit decides them. Side facts and near and far unrelated queries are those of the revision record. Yes and no are balanced: the direct question and the first instance (no), the second instance asks whether the reverse could fail (yes).
